source: FPP 10.3 WLED port; descriptions and previews from WLED-Docs and WLED-Utils (MIT)

Akemi.d: The WLED mascot rocking to your tunes.

Black Hole.d: Colorful dots orbiting a white black hole.

Blink.d: Blinks between primary and secondary color.

Blink Rainbow.d: Same as blink, cycles through the rainbow.

Blurz.d: Flash an fftResult bin per frame and then blur/fade.

Bpm.d: Pulses moving back and forth on palette.

Breathe.d: Fades between primary and secondary color.

Candle Multi.d: Like candle effect, but each LED has it's own flicker pattern.

Chase.d: 2 LEDs in primary color running on secondary.

Chase 2.d: Pattern of n LEDs primary and n LEDs secondary moves along the strip.

Chase Flash.d: 2 LEDs flash in secondary color while the rest is lit in primary. The flashing LEDs wander from start to end.

Chase Flash Rnd.d: Like Chase Flash, but the 2 LEDs flash in random colors and leaves a random color behind.

Chase Rainbow.d: Like 28 but leaves trail of rainbow.

Chase Random.d: Like Chase but leaves trail of random color.

Chunchun.d: Birds flying in a circle formation.

Color Clouds.d: Soft and slow evolving color cloud effect.

Colorloop.d: Cycle all LEDs through the rainbow colors.

Colortwinkles.d: LEDs light up randomly in random colors and fade off again.

Crazy Bees.d: Bees darting from flower to flower.

DJ Light.d: An effect emanating from the center to the edges.

DNA.d: A very cool DNA like pattern.

Dissolve.d: Fills LEDs with primary in random order, then off again.

Dissolve Rnd.d: Fills LEDs with random colors in random order, then off again.

Distortion Waves.d: Distorted sine waves with a psychedelic flair.

Drift Rose.d: Spinning arms that adds and removes nodes as it winds and unwinds.

Dynamic.d: Sets each LED to a random color.

Dynamic Smooth.d: Like Dynamic, but with smooth palette blends.

Fade.d: Fades smoothly between primary and secondary color.

Fairy.d: Inspired by twinkle style Christmas lights.

Fairytwinkle.d: Like Colortwinkle, but starting from all lit.

Fire 2012.d: Simulates flickering fire in red and yellow.

Fireworks.d: Random color blobs light up, then fade again.

Flow.d: Blend of palette and spot effects.

Freqmap.d: Map the loudest frequency throughout the length of the LED's.

Freqmatrix.d: The temporal tail for this animation starts at the beginning of the Segment rather than in the center of the segment.

Freqwave.d: Maps the major frequencies from the incoming signal to colors in the HSV color space.

Funky Plank.d: A 2D wall of reactivity running from bottom to top.

Ghost Rider.d: Color changing ghost riding a kite... in a tornado.

Gradient.d: Moves a saturation gradient of the primary color along the strip.

Gravcenter.d: Volume reactive vu-meter from center with gravity and perlin noise.

Gravcentric.d: Volume reactive vu-meter from center with gravity. Volume provides index to (time rotating) palette colour.

Gravfreq.d: VU Meter from center. Log of frequency is index to center colour.

Gravimeter.d: Volume reactive vu-meter with gravity and perlin noise.

Halloween Eyes.d: One Pair of blinking eyes at random intervals along strip.

Heartbeat.d: led strip pulsing rhythm similar to a heart beat.

ICU.d: Two "eyes" running on opposite sides of the strip.

Juggle.d: Eight colored dots running, leaving trails.

Julia.d: Animated Julia set fractal named after mathematician Gaston Julia.

Lighthouse.d: Dot moves from start to end, leaving behind a fading trail.

Lightning.d: Short random white strobe similar to a lightning bolt.

Loading.d: Moves a sawtooth pattern along the strip.

Meteor.d: The primary color creates a trail of randomly decaying color.

Multi Comet.d: Like Scanner, but creates multiple trails.

Noise Pal.d: Peaceful noise that's slow and with gradually changing palettes.

Noisefire.d: A perlin noise based volume reactive fire routine.

Noisemove.d: Using perlin noise as movement for different frequency bins.

Octopus.d: A cephalopod stuck in a whirlpool.

Oscillate.d: Areas of primary and secondary colors move between opposite ends, combining colors where they touch.

PS 1D Balance.d: Particles flowing back and forth as if the LEDs were reacting to tilt.

PS Attractor.d: Particles swirling around a black hole.

PS Chase.d: Particles chasing along the strip in a regular pattern.

PS DripDrop.d: Dripping liquid particle effect, combines the classic "Drip" and "Rain" effects with many additional options.

PS Fire.d: Versatile and quite realistic fire effect.

PS Fireworks.d: Rockets shooting up and exploding in various ways and colors.

PS Galaxy.d: Rotating galaxy-style star field with "hyper speed" option.

PS Ghost Rider.d: Spiraling trail effect like the original with more options.

PS Hourglass.d: Particles falling like sand in an hourglass.

Percent.d: Lights up a percentage of segment.

Puddlepeak.d: Blast coloured puddles randomly up and down the strand with the 'beat'.

Puddles.d: Blast coloured puddles based on volume.

Railway.d: Shows primary and secondary color on alternating LEDs. All LEDs fade to their opposite color and back again.

Rain.d: Like Fireworks, but the blobs move.

Rainbow.d: Displays rainbow colors along the whole strip.

Rainbow Runner.d: Like Chase, but the 2 LEDs light up in rainbow colors and leave a primary color trail.

Random Colors.d: Applies a new random color to all LEDs.

Ripple Rainbow.d: Like ripple, but with a dimly lit changing background.

Rocktaves.d: Colours the same for each note between octaves, with sine wave going back and forth.

Scan.d: A single primary colored light wanders between start and end.

Scan Dual.d: Same as Scan but uses two lights starting at both ends.

Scanner.d: Dot moves between ends, leaving behind a fading trail.

Scanner Dual.d: Like Scanner, but with two dots running on opposite sides.

Scrolling Text.d: Edit segment name to set text (variables #DATE, #TIME, #DDMM, #MMDD, #HHMM, #HH, #MM; suffix with 0 to have leading 0s, i.e. #DATE0). Use segment grouping to increase text size on a large matrix.

Shimmer.d: A shimmer moving across the strip with optional modulators.

Sindots.d: Dots revolving in a circle while the 'camera'.

Slow Transition.d: Very slow transitions up to 255 minutes.

Soap.d: Like soap bubbles, but lasts longer.

Solid.d: Solid primary color on all LEDs.

Solid Glitter.d: Like Glitter, but with solid color background.

Solid Pattern.d: Speed sets number of LEDs on, intensity sets off.

Spaceships.d: Circling ships with fading trails. Homage to 80s spaceship shooter games.

Sparkle.d: Single random LEDs light up in the primary color for a short time, secondary is background.

Sparkle Dark.d: All LEDs are lit in the primary color, single random LEDs turn off for a short time.

Sparkle-Plus.d: All LEDs are lit in the primary color, multiple random LEDs turn off for a short time.

Stream.d: Flush bands random hues along the string.

Stream 2.d: Flush random hues along the string.

Strobe.d: All LEDs are lit in the secondary color, all LEDs flash in a single short burst in primary color.

Strobe Mega.d: All LEDs are lit in the secondary color, all LEDs flash in several short bursts in primary color.

Strobe Rainbow.d: Same as strobe, cycles through the rainbow.

Sunrise.d: Simulates a gradual sunrise or sunset. Speed sets: 0 - static sun, 1 - 60: sunrise time in minutes,60 - 120: sunset time in minutes - 60, above: "breathing" rise and set.

Sweep.d: Switches between primary and secondary, switching LEDs one by one, start to end to start.

Sweep Random.d: Like Sweep, but uses random colors.

Swirl.d: Several blurred circles. Looks good with pink plasma palette. Supports AGC.

Tartan.d: Plaid pattern of horizontal and vertical bands. Makes a great kilt.

Theater.d: Pattern of one lit and two unlit LEDs running.

Theater Rainbow.d: Same as Theater but uses colors of the rainbow.

Tri Fade.d: Fades the whole strip from primary color to secondary color to off.

Tri Wipe.d: Like Wipe but turns LEDs off as "third color".

Twinkle.d: Random LEDs light up in the primary color with secondary as background.

Twinklecat.d: Twinkling with fast in / slow out.

Twinklefox.d: FastLED gentle twinkling with slow fade in/out.

Waterfall.d: A volume AND FFT version of a Waterfall that has 'beat' support.

Wavesins.d: Beat waves and phase shifting. Looks OK in 2D'ish as well.

Waving Cell.d: If a bunch of eucaryotes went to a sports stadium and did the wave, it would look exactly like this.

Wipe.d: Switches between primary and secondary, switching LEDs one by one, start to end.

Wipe Random.d: Same as Wipe, but uses random colors.
